mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at fair conditions with a temperature of 70 degrees near Harriet Park.

Regarding city business, property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15. You can pay them online via credit card or electronic check, or use the drop box at the City Center, which is available 24/7.

There is plenty to do in town! Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

In a noteworthy call from November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a woman unresponsive in her vehicle; she was subsequently arrested for operating while intoxicated.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The store is closed right now, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10 AM.
